svg.text: AZUL: STAINED GLASS OF SINTRA — BOARD & SETUP
Scoring Board (Track, Round Bonus & Glass Tower), Factories/Center & Palace Board
SCORING BOARD (0–100+ Track, Round Indicator & Glass Tower)
Score markers start on 0; 6 rounds total
• Score Track (0–100+): Tracks live points during game; pass 100 = 100+.
• Round Indicator (R1–R6): 1 random pane on R1 + 1 of each color on R2–R6; top pane gives +1 VP/matching pane on strip completion.
• Glass Tower: Holds excess/discarded panes and spent round panes; refills draw bag whenever bag runs empty.
• Bonus Marker: Tracks luxury/bonus glass and palace end-game bonuses (Side A ornaments or Side B window x color).
FACTORY DISPLAYS & CENTER TABLE
Factories: 5 (2p) • 7 (3p) • 9 (4p) — 4 panes each
Center Pool & Start Player Marker Rule
• Taking 1 color from a factory pushes remaining panes to Center.
• Start Player Rule: ONLY the 1st player to take from Center in a
round gets the Start Player marker AND moves their Broken Glass
marker down 1 space (later center picks in that round do not).
• Start player places Start Player token in Center on Round 1, then acts.
• 100 pane pieces total (20 per color across 5 pane colors).
PALACE BOARD: GLAZIER ON TOP OF STRIPS & BROKEN GLASS
Place panes ONLY ON or RIGHT of Glazier
BROKEN GLASS TRACK & EXCESS PANES
• Excess panes (no matching space or not enough room on chosen strip) drop into Glass Tower; move Broken Glass marker down 1/pane.
• 1st player to take from Center each round also moves Broken Glass marker down 1 space (and claims Start Player marker).
• Passing the bottom (-18) deducts 18 VP immediately and resets marker to top of Broken Glass track; final penalty applies after R6.
KEY RULES & SYMBOLS GLOSSARY
• Glazier Position & Movement: Starts above leftmost strip; moves right to chosen strip when drafting on a strip to its right (never
moves left during drafting). To go back to leftmost strip, take a full turn choosing "Move Glazier" instead of drafting.
• Strip Completed (All 5 Panes): Score window below strip + windows to its right holding 1–2 panes + 1 VP/matching Round pane;
keep 1 pane in window frame below, drop 4 into Glass Tower, flip strip (1st time) or remove strip (2nd time).
• Bonus Marker & End-Game Scoring: +1 VP per 3 leftover strip panes; Side A = 10/6/3/0 VP per ornament (4/3/2/1 panes);
Side B = completed 2-pane windows x panes of 1 chosen color; subtract Broken Glass penalty. Tie-breaker: least Broken Glass loss.
AZUL: STAINED GLASS OF SINTRA — TURN FLOW
Round Refill, Turn Choices (Draft vs. Move Glazier), Strip Completion & Scoring
STEP 1
ROUND START
Fill Factories & Begin Round (Rounds 1–6)
1. Deal 4 panes from bag to each factory (5 / 7 / 9 for 2 / 3 / 4p); Round 1 places Start token in Center first.
2. Start Player goes first; top pane on Round Track sets this round's color bonus (+1 VP per matching pane).
STEP 2: PLAYER TURN — CHOOSE DRAFT PANES OR MOVE GLAZIER
Action A: Draft Glass Panes & Place
• Factory: Take ALL panes of 1 color; push rest to Center.
• Center: Take ALL panes of 1 color from Center.
• 1st Center Claim in Round:
ONLY the 1st player to claim from Center gets Start
Player marker + moves Broken Glass down 1 space.
• Place on 1 Strip (At or Right of Glazier):
Match colors on 1 strip at/right of Glazier; move Glazier
right to that strip if needed (never left when drafting).
• Excess Panes -> Broken Glass:
Unplaceable/extra panes go to Glass Tower; move
Broken Glass marker down 1 space per broken pane.
Action B: Move Glazier (No Draft)
Instead of drafting glass panes, spend your
turn moving your Glazier back to the
leftmost pattern strip (over a strip).
Rules & Purpose:
• Forbidden if Glazier is already on the
leftmost strip (must draft instead).
• Resets position when Glazier is too
far right for available table colors.
• Ends turn immediately (no draft).
WHEN A STRIP IS COMPLETELY FILLED (All 5 Spaces Filled):
1. Score window points below strip + points from windows to its right holding 1–2 panes + 1 VP/matching Round pane.
2. Keep 1 pane in window frame below, drop 4 in Glass Tower; flip strip (1st time) or remove strip (2nd time).
STEP 3
ROUND END
End of Round & Next Round Transition
1. Round ends when no panes remain on any factory display or in the center pool.
2. Remove top pane from the Round Track and drop it into the Glass Tower.
3. If Round < 6: Refill factories with 4 panes/each from bag (refill bag from Glass Tower if empty); Start token holder leads.
* Broken Glass marker stays on its track across rounds until final scoring (resets only if passing -18).
END OF GAME (AFTER ROUND 6): FINAL SCORING & WINNER
Combine your score track total with end-of-game bonuses and deductions:
1. Leftover Strip Panes: Gain +1 VP for every 3 panes remaining on your pattern strips (rounded down).
2. Broken Glass Penalty: Subtract the negative points shown at your Broken Glass track position.
3. Palace Board Side Bonus: Side A = 10/6/3/0 VP per ornament by filled neighbors (4/3/2/1); Side B =
completed 2-pane windows x total panes of 1 chosen color on your palace board.
Highest Final Score Wins • Tie-Breaker: Least points lost on Broken Glass track (else shared win).
